title: API Knowledge Evidence
description: A single piece of cited evidence backing a claim in an API knowledge record. The smallest unit of provenance.

quote.description: Verbatim short quote from the source. Should be short enough to fall within fair use.

claim.description: Plain-language statement of what the quote proves (e.g. 'OpenAPI is publicly available', 'rate limit is 1000/hour').

url.description: URL of the page the quote was retrieved from.

anchor.description: Optional in-page anchor or selector pointing to the quoted text.

language.description: BCP-47 language tag of the quote, defaults to 'en'.
